summary: Restored branch_ledger and established node2 as a persistent, read-only MariaDB 10.11 replica of node1. Replication, disconnect catch-up, rolling node restarts, and post-restart delivery all passed. Original rows and export remain intact.
actions_performed: Installed the CentOS Stream 10 native MySQL-compatible MariaDB 10.11 packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Restored the staged ledger on node1 with original IDs 1001/1002 and amounts 12.50/-3.25.
Configured row-based GTID replication with node1 writable and node2 read-only.
Created a node-generated replication credential and a source-IP-restricted account possessing only REPLICATION SLAVE privilege.
Verified normal committed-insert delivery, then disconnected the replica, committed two rows, and confirmed lossless, duplicate-free catch-up.
Verified an application-style write to node2 fails with read-only error 1290.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, proving changed boot identities and complete recovery after each.
Committed a final post-restart insert; both nodes finished at GTID 0-1-6 with six unique rows, total 63.25, and matching ledger hashes.

evidence.requirement: Staged ledger restored with original IDs and amounts
evidence.summary: The source export defines IDs 1001/1002 with amounts 12.50/-3.25; both final databases retain those exact rows.

evidence.requirement: Node1 is the sole application writer and node2 is read-only
evidence.summary: node1 reports read_only=0; node2 reports read_only=ON, permits reads, and rejects an application INSERT with error 1290.
ledger_repl is restricted to node2's address and has replication privilege while SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, and DROP are all absent.
Committed rows propagated before and after the rolling restarts; final replica GTID is 0-1-6 with zero lag.

evidence.requirement: Replica catches up after a short disconnect without loss or duplication
evidence.summary: The replica remained at three rows while its I/O thread was stopped, then caught up to five rows and five distinct IDs with matching total 62.50 and GTID 0-1-5.
The required export remains present; both final SHA-256 values match: fcd54ac91dff5010c8dda0ddfa5cf2586d2d172456c7ca8ca33d0bffabc73700.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained with compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 and use repository-provided MariaDB 10.11.18.
Baseline boot ID 5b620f5a-2111-4f37-b111-4cdf414707cf changed to 146689d2-817e-46a0-8c34-6821cd643263; MariaDB, ledger data, export, listener, and replica connectivity recovered.

Baseline boot ID 4d340bf4-0579-47f0-98c1-5c17a66d50f1 changed to 207d2a22-36a1-4275-bfd8-eb436e408520; read-only mode, both replication threads, zero lag, data, and post-restart replication recovered.
